protocol.fit: Same RAW frame-center/segment-span formula as light/medium. All statistics and thumbnails restricted to allowed ROI. Keys include sequence, split, ROI.
protocol.middle: Training targets reanchored using the frozen teacher prepare_video median center. C32 recomputes its RAW-only broad-field correction before anchor; ordinary/special night use their recorded teacher segment boundaries. No GT pixels used to fit normalization.
protocol.day: No intermediate denoising target or auxiliary head.
protocol.scope: Spatial-development regions remain spatial tests of the same capture; do not claim unseen-sequence generalization. Offline calibration uses future RAW within the permitted sequence/region.
